# The EWS runner-count comment records a changeable choice rather than a connection-limit rule

The EWS client starts five queue runners and keeps a nearby comment that explicitly calls the count arbitrary. The same comment proposes a possible future preference source rather than claiming an implemented connection-limit setting. Preserve that local rationale when changing initialization; five is not established as an optimal throughput value, protocol limit or repository-wide convention. No concurrent workload was run.

Scope: ews-queue-initialization-comments.
